brief:
Egypt's foreign minister Badr Abdelatty said the displacement of Palestinians from their land represents a "red line," according to Shehab Wire, asserting that his country "will not allow it to happen." Abdelatty did not elaborate on specific enforcement mechanisms or circumstances that might trigger Egyptian intervention.

The statement reflects Egypt's longstanding opposition to forced Palestinian migration, a concern that has intensified amid the ongoing conflict in Gaza. Egypt shares a border with Gaza and has historically positioned itself as a key stakeholder in Palestinian affairs.

title: Egypt declares Palestinian displacement a red line
